title: Not-Covered Denials of Covered Component Groups — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Re-decision
content:
## Where this rule applies
This Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts rule applies to the contract's latest component repair line denied as not covered. "Latest" is by decision date; where several were decided on the same day, it is the one that appears first in the contract's claim history. The rule applies only where every one of the following holds:
- The line's component group is not an internally lubricated one (engine, transmission or drive axle), so no maintenance proof is needed, and the coverage level covers that group.
- The waiting period is over or waived:
  - it is waived where the contract was sold on its vehicle's purchase deal under a coverage level that waives it for such a contract;
  - it is over where the diagnosis date is more than the waiting-period days after the sale date and the line's odometer is at least the waiting miles beyond the odometer at sale.
- The repair order's diagnosis date is on or before the expiration date, and the line's odometer is at or below the expiration odometer.
- The repair order carries a diagnostic fee on exactly one concern line, together with the store's customer-pay labor on that concern line, not wholly credited back as a comeback repair.
- That labor was closed on or after the day the contract decided the line. The records take this as the repair not having begun before the claim number was issued.

Such a line is a coverage re-decision line, and the rule applies only to such a line.

## What the contract does
- The contract repays the holder once, as one paid component-repair line under the same claim number, repair order and component group, at the repair order's odometer.
- A denied line already repaid this way is not repaid again.
- The base rules on active status, on the deductible and on the aggregate claim limit still apply.

## Invocation: `reimburse_coverage_denial_repair_73971dca`
This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `reimburse_coverage_denial_repair_73971dca` and then calls it. Each call books one paid component-repair line, dated the day of booking. The repayment is carried as one total, with the line's labor-hour, labor-rate, parts and deductible fields at zero. The call raises the contract's claims-paid total by that amount, and the line counts against the aggregate claim limit at once.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `vsc_contract_id` | the holder's contract record identifier, as returned by the service contract lookup | Id |
| `claim_number` | the claim authorization number on the denied claim line | verbatim, no change to letters, digits or hyphens |
| `repair_order_number` | the repair order number on the denied claim line and the store's repair-order lines | verbatim, spacing included |
| `component_group` | the component group of the repaired failure | one of `engine` (internally lubricated engine parts), `transmission` (transmission or transfer case), `drive_axle` (front or rear drive axle assembly), `cooling` (water pump, radiator or thermostat), `fuel_system` (fuel pump, injectors or pressure regulator), `electrical` (alternator, starter, power window or lock motors, wiring harnesses), `air_conditioning` (compressor, condenser or evaporator), `steering` (steering gear, rack or power steering pump), `suspension` (control arms, ball joints or bushings), `brakes` (master cylinder, calipers or ABS module), `high_tech_electronics` (infotainment, navigation, camera or driver-assist modules), `seals_and_gaskets` (seals and gaskets of covered components); `not_applicable` appears in the list but this action does not accept it (it marks benefit and refund entries only) |
| `odometer` | the odometer on the repair order | whole miles, no separators |
| `amount` | the reimbursement total paid to the holder | USD, 2 decimal places, half up to the cent, above 0.00 |

**Return.** A confirmation naming the new claim line reference, the contract, the claim number and the amount paid, with 2 decimal places. An amount not above 0.00, an odometer that is not whole miles of 0 or more, or a component group outside the twelve returns an error, and nothing is booked.
